Class OtelMetricsRecorder

java.lang.Object
com.cockroachlabs.crdb.metrics.OtelMetricsRecorder
All Implemented Interfaces:
MetricsRecorder
public final class OtelMetricsRecorder extends Object implements MetricsRecorder
A MetricsRecorder that exports to OpenTelemetry through a Meter. Instrument names are shared across the sibling libraries so a single dashboard works regardless of the implementation language.

Instruments:

  • cockroachdb.transactions.total (counter, attribute success)
  • cockroachdb.transactions.duration (histogram, ms)
  • cockroachdb.retries.attempts (counter)
  • cockroachdb.retries.exhausted (counter)
  • cockroachdb.circuit.opens (counter)

Obtain the Meter from your application's MeterProvider, e.g. GlobalOpenTelemetry.getMeter("cockroachdb-java-library").
